eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent Computing and AI Applications in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (ICICAI-2K26) is a premier global event that gathers leading experts, researchers, policymakers and practitioners to explore and discuss the latest advancements in the areas of Renewable Energy, Electric Transportation, Power Electronics, Electric Drives, Control Techniques, Smart Grids, Communication Protocols, Intelligent Charging Infrastructure and Standards. This conference is a critical platform for fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing among those committed to addressing some of the most pressing challenges facing our world today.
